sv_m	CREATE DATABASE `sv_m` /*!40100 DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci */ /*!80016 DEFAULT ENCRYPTION='N' */
customers	CREATE TABLE `customers` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `email` varchar(100) NOT NULL COMMENT 'login, with ''quote'' and\nnewline',
  `name` varchar(80) CHARACTER SET latin1 COLLATE latin1_swedish_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `score` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT '0.00',
  `full_name` varchar(200) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (concat(convert(`name` using utf8mb4),_utf8mb4' ',`email`)) VIRTUAL,
  `status` enum('a','b','c') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'a',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_email` (`email`),
  KEY `idx_name` (`name`(10)),
  KEY `idx_created` (`created_at` DESC),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_score` CHECK ((`score` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=2 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Customers'
item_tags	CREATE TABLE `item_tags` (
  `item_id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `tag` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`item_id`,`tag`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tag_item` FOREIGN KEY (`item_id`) REFERENCES `items` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
items	CREATE TABLE `items` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL,
  `label` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
legacy	CREATE TABLE `legacy` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
logs	CREATE TABLE `logs` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `at` date NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`,`at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
/*!50100 PARTITION BY RANGE (year(`at`))
(PARTITION p2025 VALUES LESS THAN (2026) ENGINE = InnoDB,
 PARTITION p2026 VALUES LESS THAN (2027) ENGINE = InnoDB) */
notes	CREATE TABLE `notes` (
  `id` int NOT NULL,
  `body` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` char(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=latin1
orders	CREATE TABLE `orders` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

  CONSTRAINT `fk_orders_customer` FOREIGN KEY (`customer_id`) REFERENCES `customers` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci
